about: Usual prices at Bangkok tourist-area markets and stalls, THB. Ranges come from the sources listed per item (researched 2026-10-15). Where a range is derived from several figures rather than published as a range, 'derived' explains how. Mango is seasonal: this range is for October (off-season).

keywordsTh: มะม่วงน้ำดอกไม้
items.derived: October off-season figures: TrueID retail 80, Si Mueang ripe 100, Simummuang 105 (via checkraka.app), Lotus's ripe Nam Dok Mai 99. In season (Mar-Jun) local markets are 30-60.

items.derived: Two price levels: chain cafe (Cafe Amazon) 55-85, specialty cafes on Thonglor/Ekkamai 130-180. A price above 180 is high anywhere; 130-180 is normal only at specialty cafes.

sources.quote: A latte at Roots Coffee on Thonglor or Brave Roasters near Ekkamai runs 130 to 180 THB.

items.derived: Official meter tariff since 13 Jan 2023: first km 35 (large taxi 40), then 6.50 per km up to 10 km. 5 km = 35 + 4 x 6.50 = 61 (large 66). Excludes 3 THB per minute in traffic, 20 THB phone/app booking fee and 50 THB airport surcharge. Only fair for about 5 km; a longer ride costs more.

sources.title: Thai PBS: new Bangkok taxi fares
sources.quote: ระยะทาง 1 กิโลเมตรแรก 35 บาท ระยะทางเกินกว่า 1-10 กม.ละ 6.50 บาท
